prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with whiplash after a low-speed head-on collision. The patient had 28 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1087; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment ran somewhat longer than usual for this injury.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a low-speed head-on motor vehicle collision with complaints of neck pain, stiffness, and headache consistent with whiplash-type cervical injury. The mechanism of the collision and the force involved are well matched to the injury reported. Over the course of care the patient attended 28 visits, a somewhat longer course than is typical for this presentation, with treatment directed at restoring cervical range of motion, reducing muscle guarding, and managing pain through manual therapy, graded exercise, and home program instruction. Imaging and physical examination findings clearly confirm the injury. No prior injury to the cervical spine or surrounding soft tissue is known to this office. Billing records reviewed for this course of care show no duplicated or repeated charges for the same services. At last assessment the patient reported partial improvement in symptoms with ongoing but diminishing limitations in neck mobility. Continued home exercise and periodic reassessment are recommended, with return precautions reviewed.
